stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The ocean may look empty from above, but it is full of signals.”?

Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.
Art may use new tools, but audiences still listen for human intention.
Human activity can interrupt conversations we are only beginning to understand.
